## **Цена и paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Цена и paywall.**
      7 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: цена и paywall.
      Период отзывов: 15 авг. 2026 г. - 4 сент. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают цену, подписку или paywall. Это сигнал чувствительности к монетизации.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _@dopedamaris_, 1 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "Once upon a time using the bar code feature was free and basic…now it’s behind a paywall"
            2. _Leemiz_, 22 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "Every three clicks on the app prompts it asking me to buy premium. No. I don’t want it and clicking so all the time is very very annoying"
            3. _Justin G. San Francisco_, 4 сент. 2026 г., 2/5: "I love using the MFP but the last few months the app has been glitching. It disappears right after I log in, even after updates and reinstalling it. I’ve tried everything but it’s still disappearing and I can’t use it. I may need to cancel my subscription if I don’t get the technical support I need which I’ve reached out for and have yet to receive."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Баги и стабильность** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Баги и стабильность.**
      4 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: баги и стабильность.
      Период отзывов: 18 июн. 2026 г. - 2 сент. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают краши или нестабильность. Это actionable только при всплеске или после обновления; иначе часто baseline-шум.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _bigmomAsoup696969_, 2 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "I’ve used this app FOR YEARS, from my teens well into adulthood, and every year and every update it’s more and more paywalls. Paywalls for what used to be free features of the app. I still remember when you could insert your own macros of a food that wasn’t logged, and I still remember when you could dial in your macros and calories numbers without the need of a slider and percentages. This is app is a shadow of its former self in every aspect. If you enjoy this app how it is now, DO NOT UPDATE IT. This app will most likely be unusable in the next 3 years or so. Solely because most features wont be accessible without dishing them some money."
            2. _Verczeska_, 24 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "I have been a user since early 2010s. I loved it and I recommended it to all friends, family and clients. The new update made it all unusable, I find it hard to see what I actually consumed. Bring the old version back."
            3. _Jen,seeking resolution_, 17 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "Terrible navigation, continually have Mondays entries end up on the following Sunday, no longer is there mass delete, various editing functions gone, way more clicks to add and delete, hideous UI and UX, glitchy. Did anyone bother to even do a feature gap analysis before deploying this junk that has had nothing but terrible reviews none of which have they remedied or even addressed? Boycot these people"
<!--/ir-theme-->
